title: Favorite old trombone players: Sonny Henry, Joe Petit, Showboy
summary: De De names trombonists he liked, including the Petit brothers and Showboy Thomas.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you, who were some of your favorite trombone players from the old days?
Well, like I said, Sonny, I remember how he was. I remember the brothers, several of them, before my time.
Petit, yes. I like his playing. Who? Showboy.
I forget his name, old man Petit. He played a bit.
Is that Buddy's stepfather or uncle or something? Stepfather or uncle or something.
Something else in relation. That's Joe Petit. That's Joe Petit. That's Joe Petit, yeah.
And Showboy is worthy of Thomas. Yeah, that's his real name. Oh, yeah.
Well, Showboy, we call him Showboy.
